prompt: Use case: identity-preserve and compositing. Asset type: personalised welcome illustration for the Kinfolk family planner. Image 1 is the edit target and the style/composition reference: the warm painted cartoon of a family at a breakfast table. Image 2 is the sole identity reference: the supplied real family portrait. Replace the five illustrated people's faces and hairstyles with recognisable, carefully cartooned likenesses of the five corresponding people in Image 2. Map the father at the right of the portrait to the father seated at the left of the illustration; map the mother at the left of the portrait to the illustrated mother in the mustard-yellow sweater; map the older boy in the middle of the portrait to the 10-year-old boy in the striped shirt; map the younger boy in front of the father in the portrait to the 6-year-old boy in the green sweater at the right; map the baby girl in the white dress and floral headband to the infant girl on the mother's lap. Preserve each person's individual facial proportions, complexion, eyes, nose, cheeks, lips, hairline and smile from the real photo. Give the father the reference man's short close-cropped black hair, fuller face and subtle moustache/chin hair, rather than the original illustration's curly hair and full beard. Give the mother the reference woman's fuller cheeks and face and long black twists gathered high and flowing down, instead of the original illustrated bun. Both boys should have the short close-cropped hair seen in the portrait and their own distinct recognisable faces. Preserve the infant's round cheeks, eyes, short hair and floral headband. Adapt the faces into the SAME coherent hand-painted storybook cartoon/gouache style as Image 1; do not paste photographic faces into the painting, and do not make generic substitute faces. Let the faces turn slightly towards the viewer where helpful for likeness while preserving the warm family interaction. Keep exactly two adult parents, two boys visibly aged 10 and 6, and one infant baby girl. Keep the existing illustrated clothing colours, sunny cream-and-green kitchen, breakfast table, food, plants, lighting and overall 3:2 landscape composition. No dog, animals, extra people, lettering, text, logos or watermarks.
